Title
AN ACT relating to state symbols; designating the blue elderberry as the official state fruit of the State of Nevada; and providing other matters properly relating thereto. Close title
AN ACT relating to state symbols; designating the blue elderberry as the official state fruit of the State of Nevada; and providing other matters properly relating thereto.
Digest
Existing law establishes various symbols of the State of Nevada. (NRS 235.020-235.145) Section 1 of this bill designates the blue elderberry as the official state fruit of the State of Nevada. Close digest
